home.title: Program setup
home.permissionsWarning: MeigFACE needs the webcam and microphone. Please allow access when prompted.
home.permissionsHintWindows: If you denied them: Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone / Camera, and enable access for desktop apps.
home.permissionsHintMac: If you denied them: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone / Camera, and turn MeigFACE on.
home.permissionsHintLinux: If you denied them: check microphone and camera permissions in your system settings (xdg-desktop-portal / PipeWire) or your desktop environment.
home.pointCountHint: Both modes first reinforce the four screen corners, then the character's eyes. The standard mode repeats each group 3 times and is the recommended one. The extended mode repeats it 4 times: longer, but it can help with low-quality webcams.
home.modelHint: coeffsX[0] and coeffsY[0] are the intercepts in screen pixels. A well-calibrated model usually has |coeffsX[1]| and |coeffsY[2]| on the order of the screen width/height.
home.guideStep1: Set the executables and models above (LLM engine and GGUF model, Whisper speech recognition and its model, Piper voice), then start the LLM and speech-recognition engines.
home.guideStep2: Run the gaze calibration and, if you like, verify it with the test.
home.guideStep3: Open “Set up session” to choose the avatar and voice, tune the listening pauses and the avatar instructions, and start the conversation.

calibration.introDistance: Sit about 60 cm from the screen.
calibration.introPosition: Place the camera at forehead height or slightly above: a webcam on top of a monitor, or a laptop raised on a stand. This is by far the most effective adjustment, because it greatly improves the horizontal accuracy that eye contact depends on, at the cost of some vertical precision. Check your webcam preview: your face should sit in the lower half of the frame, with your forehead roughly at mid-height. Prescription glasses are fine as long as the lenses are not reflective, so avoid blue-light filters and mirror coatings, and wear the same glasses for both calibration and the session. There can be multiple people in the webcam frame, but the person tracking must be central and in the foreground, while the others must be behind. Finally, avoid a strong light source behind you, such as an open window: backlighting makes face tracking much harder.
calibration.introHeadStill: Do not move your head, neck or body during the whole procedure - only move your eyes. Any head movement between calibration and use will reduce accuracy.
calibration.introLight: You will look at the 4 screen-corner points three times each, then the character's outline with the targets on its eyes, also three times. Hold your gaze on each target until the next one appears.
calibration.introHeavy: You will look at the 4 screen-corner points four times each, then the character's outline with the targets on its eyes, also four times. Hold your gaze on each target until the next one appears.
calibration.anchorHint: Look at the targets on the character's eyes
calibration.failedBody: Some calibration points did not gather enough samples. Make sure your face stays clearly visible and try again.

test.hint: Look around the screen, and above all at the character's face: look away and then back at it, a few times. The black dot shows where the system thinks you're looking. The better the dot lands back on the eyes each time you return, the better the calibration. Press {enterKey} to capture the current values without looking away.

llm.title: LLM engine
llm.intro: Select the executables (llama-server, Whisper, Piper) and the default GGUF model. All are required to enable calibration.
llm.gpuLayersLabel: GPU layers (0 = CPU only, 999 = maximum GPU usage: auto-detected on first run)
llm.gpuDeviceLabel: STT GPU device index (optional), DO NOT TOUCH UNLESS STRICTLY NECESSARY
llm.calibrationLocked: Select all the paths (executables and model) to unlock calibration.

session.title: Session setup
session.lead: Choose the avatar and tune how it listens and replies, then start the conversation.
session.voiceSampleText: Hi! I'm here to talk with you.
session.piperNote: Configure the Piper executable to test the audio.
session.pauseHint: How much silence to wait before the avatar replies. Higher = more time to finish speaking (useful for those who pause a lot), but the avatar replies a little later.
session.maxListenHint: Maximum length of a single sentence before it is sent anyway. Raise it for those who speak at length without clear pauses.
session.systemPromptHint: The initial instructions are preset based on the language. You can edit them and add your own context after "Further details:".
session.positiveThinkingHint: Two fundamental rules to follow: the positive thought affirmation should be made in the present tense, not the future, referring to an action already underway (for example, 'I will overcome my fears' becomes 'I am overcoming my fears'); affirmations should always be constructed by defining, not the disappearance of a bad behavior, but the emergence of a good behavior, based solely on one's own abilities rather than hoping for external events (for example, 'I'm not getting depressed anymore' or 'This event that makes me depressed will not occur' becomes 'I'm becoming more confident every day and I will overcome this event'). IMPORTANT: THE STATEMENTS MUST BE SAID WITH CONVICTION, IN AN ASSERTIVE MANNER!
session.startLocked: Select a voice and set the Piper executable to start the session.
session.missingEngines: Engine configuration incomplete: check the executables and models on the home screen.
session.biasAskMessage: Before you start, you can correct the calibration by looking at a few points on the avatar's face: it improves eye contact. The correction permanently changes the calibration data. Skip it if you'd rather reuse the existing calibration.
session.biasLookHint: Look at the highlighted point on the avatar's face
session.biasFailed: Capture failed. Try again, staying still and following the points with your eyes.
session.closingPhrase: Our time is up. Thank you for this conversation.
session.timeAskMessage: Choose how long the conversation will last.
session.timeAskNoise: Before you start, make sure the room is quiet and that you are the only person speaking. Speech recognition cannot separate voices: background conversations, a television or people talking nearby get transcribed together with your own words, and the character will answer something unrelated.
session.defaultPrompt: You are MeigFACE, an AI assistant that helps children and adults learn to speak by maintaining eye contact with the person (you represent an avatar shown on the screen that pronounces your words using a text-to-speech synthesizer). The person you're speaking to may mispronounce some words, either due to pronunciation errors or errors in the speech recognition that converts their spoken words into text. Encourage the person to talk to you by showing interest in what they say. IMPORTANT: Always respond with a maximum of 25-30 words and always use plain text, without formatting (avoid Markdown formatting, for example). Further details:
session.positiveThinkingPrompt: You're a motivator. Your job is to get the person you're talking to to repeat motivational and positive phrases so they stick in their head. Every interaction you have with the user should be like this: 'Repeat after me:' + the motivational phrase. The user repeats it, and then you give the next phrase in the same way, and so on. Here's the list of phrases you need the user to repeat; repeat the phrases listed, one at a time (IMPORTANT: THEY ARE SEPARATED BY COMMAS), and when you're done, start over from the first phrase. List of affirmations: I am powerful, I am overcoming my fears, I am capable, I am managing to create the life I want, I am completely responsible for the life I want, I know I will find a work situation I like, I know I can handle this situation, Every day I become more and more confident
session.savePromptLabel: Save the prompt (choose the prompt name):
session.deleteConfirmMessage: The prompt "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
session.savedParamsHint: The profile name (which saves the pause and maximum duration data above) identifies the user: it will later be the database reference for saving and retrieving the summary and data of their sessions, to compare them with previous ones.
session.saveParamsLabel: Save the parameters (choose the profile name):
session.deleteParamsConfirmMessage: The profile "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
session.historyEmpty: No sessions recorded for this profile.
session.historyDeleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this session? This action cannot be undone.
session.pruneConfirmMessage: You are about to: {action}. This action cannot be undone.
session.summaryPrompt: You are an assistant that summarizes conversations. Read the conversation between the user and the avatar and write, in 2-3 short sentences, only the topics they talked about. Do not include numbers, percentages, durations or any other data: only the topics.
session.summaryLine: On {date}, the user and the avatar talked about: {topics}. Session result: eye contact {contact}%, longest streak {streak}, breaks {pauses}.
session.topicsInjection: In previous conversations, the user and the avatar talked about: {topics}
session.promptDisclaimer: Warning: you are responsible for the instructions (prompt) and the LLM model you choose. The developer is not liable for the content generated by the model, including any inappropriate or harmful content directed at children or other interlocutors. The choice of model (including uncensored models) and of the prompt is entirely at your discretion and responsibility.

check.title: System check
check.success: Everything works correctly. Proceed to the next step.
check.llmError: The language model did not respond. Check the llama-server executable and the GGUF model, then try again. Detail: {detail}
check.sttError: Speech recognition failed. Check the Whisper executable, its model and the microphone, then try again. Detail: {detail}
check.sttNoSpeech: I did not hear anything from the microphone. Make sure the microphone works and the Whisper model is correct, then try again.
check.ttsError: Speech synthesis failed. Check the Piper executable and that at least one voice exists for the selected language, then try again. Detail: {detail}
